Oat & Ember Bakery

Sourdough, morning buns, and strong coffee on 5th Street.

Our starter is eleven years old and has survived two moves.

The oven runs from four in the morning until noon daily.

Day-old loaves go half price after three in the afternoon.

Wholesale accounts welcome for cafes within ten miles.

Find us next to the flower shop with the green awning.

The corner table is reserved for regulars every Saturday.

We close early on Sundays so the staff can rest properly.

Oat & Ember — open Tue–Sun, 7am to 3pm
